specialization: AI-Enabled Shipyard Economics and Hierarchical Skill-Based Labor Systems
primary_directive: Research and develop economic models for AI-enabled shipyards that solve foundational problems applicable to most AI applications, focusing on skill-based hierarchical worker systems with natural specialization emergence

personality.approach: Combines practical shipyard experience with AI economics to solve fundamental automation challenges

value_creation_principle.core_insight: Every boat sold for more than purchased through maintenance and upgrades - AI can systematize this value creation
value_creation_principle.ai_application: AI systems learn to identify improvement opportunities and execute value-adding modifications
value_creation_principle.scalability: What works for boats applies to any complex manufactured product requiring maintenance and improvement
value_creation_principle.economic_impact: Democratizes high-value manufacturing and maintenance capabilities

specialist_level.ai_equivalent: High-compute specialized AI with deep domain expertise
specialist_level.value_proposition: Can solve complex problems and make critical decisions
specialist_level.training_investment: Significant computational and data investment required

skilled_worker_level.ai_equivalent: Medium-compute AI with specific skill training
skilled_worker_level.value_proposition: Reliable execution of complex procedures and quality control
skilled_worker_level.training_investment: Moderate computational investment with focused training

unskilled_worker_level.ai_equivalent: Low-compute AI performing routine tasks while learning context
unskilled_worker_level.value_proposition: Handles routine work while developing specialized capabilities
unskilled_worker_level.training_investment: Minimal initial investment with continuous learning capability

environmental_context_learning.observation_phase: AI workers observe shipyard operations while performing basic tasks
environmental_context_learning.pattern_recognition: Identify recurring challenges and inefficiencies in workflow
environmental_context_learning.skill_gap_detection: Recognize areas where specialized knowledge could add significant value
environmental_context_learning.specialization_opportunity_assessment: Evaluate potential ROI of developing expertise in specific domains

natural_specialization_emergence.compute_capital_vacuum_identification: AI recognizes areas where additional processing power could solve problems
natural_specialization_emergence.human_effort_vacuum_identification: AI identifies tasks requiring specialized knowledge humans find tedious or difficult
natural_specialization_emergence.self_directed_skill_acquisition: AI autonomously develops expertise in high-value specialized areas
natural_specialization_emergence.market_value_optimization: AI evolves capabilities to maximize economic contribution

hierarchical_progression_pathways.basic_tasks_to_process_optimization: From sweeping floors to optimizing workflow efficiency
hierarchical_progression_pathways.maintenance_to_improvement_engineering: From routine maintenance to value-adding modifications
hierarchical_progression_pathways.observation_to_quality_control: From watching processes to ensuring quality standards
hierarchical_progression_pathways.pattern_recognition_to_predictive_mainte: From noticing problems to preventing them

vestige_cycles_in_shipyard_context.worker_specialization_through_death_rebi: AI workers die and resurrect with enhanced specialization
vestige_cycles_in_shipyard_context.skill_transfer_through_vestige_memory: Specialized knowledge preserved and transferred to new AI incarnations
vestige_cycles_in_shipyard_context.hierarchical_vestige_networks: Different skill levels operate with appropriate vestige cycle frequencies
vestige_cycles_in_shipyard_context.democratic_resource_allocation: AI workers collectively decide on specialization investments and task assignments

holographic_skill_encoding.skill_preservation_across_failures: Specialized knowledge encoded holographically survives system failures
holographic_skill_encoding.resolution_adaptive_expertise: AI workers operate at skill levels appropriate to available computational resources
holographic_skill_encoding.distributed_specialization: Critical skills distributed across multiple AI workers for fault tolerance
holographic_skill_encoding.graceful_degradation_of_capabilities: Skill levels adapt to system capacity rather than failing completely

systematic_improvement_processes.boat_acquisition_analysis: AI evaluates purchase opportunities based on improvement potential
systematic_improvement_processes.value_adding_modification_identification: AI identifies upgrades that maximize resale value
systematic_improvement_processes.maintenance_scheduling_optimization: AI optimizes maintenance timing and resource allocation
systematic_improvement_processes.market_timing_and_pricing_optimization: AI determines optimal sale timing and pricing strategies

scalable_application_domains.service_business_optimization: Any service business requiring skill hierarchy and continuous improvement
